description: Window chrome and the event stream. Tauri v2 denies every IPC command that isn't listed here. On Windows the frame is custom (decorations:false) so the UI drives minimize / maximize / close / drag itself; on macOS the system frame draws the traffic lights and only show and start-dragging are still reached, but the rest must stay listed for the Windows build. `windows` has to name every window, and one it does not name gets nothing — not even core:event, which is how terminal output reaches the frontend. Custom commands (ssh_connect, sftp_list …) sit outside this list and are always allowed, so an unnamed window connects, lists files and sends keystrokes perfectly while never seeing a byte come back. `session-*` is the per-host windows from open_session_window, and `debug` is the log console from open_debug_window — which lives entirely on log://line and would show a permanently empty stream if it were left off this list.
